capabilities: generate text notes from photos using the Photes.IO AI service
capture a photo with the toolbar camera icon and convert it to a note
generate notes from existing photos in the notebook
track and purchase credits for the AI API
disambiguation: It does not edit or organize images in the vault; it converts image content into text notes via an external AI service.
extras: Usage requires an internet connection since images are uploaded to the AI service; the README links to a pricing page, a privacy policy, and terms of service.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a photo into an editable text note, so users must transcribe or describe images manually.

relations.evidence: Thank you to them makers of Image Context Menus, as it was a greate reference for reading image

requires.name: Photes.IO credits (free users get a default amount; more must be purchased)

summary: Sends images to the Photes.IO AI service and inserts generated text notes from those photos into the vault.
